title: Software Engineer - Backend (Java)
descriptionText:
About Atlassian
Atlassian builds products in developer collaboration tools. We are hiring a Software Engineer - Backend (Java) to join our engineering team in Bengaluru.

What you will do
- Design, build and own Java services that handle high request volumes with low latency.
- Write clean, well-tested code and take part in code reviews and design discussions.
- Build and maintain REST APIs and integrations with internal and partner systems.
- Work with product managers and other engineers to ship features end to end.
- Improve observability, reliability and performance of production systems.
- Contribute to Spring Boot-based components and help improve our deployment pipeline.

What we are looking for (mandatory)
- 2-5 years of professional software development experience.
- Strong hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Microservices.
- Working knowledge of AWS, PostgreSQL.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Good to have
- Exposure to Kafka, Kubernetes.

Benefits: health insurance, learning budget, flexible hours.
